doc.title: Malignant hyperthermia
doc.story: A fit 35-year-old man on the table, breathing room air: premedicated with midazolam and fentanyl, preoxygenated, induced with propofol and succinylcholine, intubated and maintained on sevoflurane 2 %. The jaw is stiff after the succinylcholine. Minutes into surgery the EtCO₂ climbs at the same ventilation and the heart rate rises; untreated, the core temperature passes 38.5 °C about 19 minutes after induction and he arrests in VF at 42 °C about 45 minutes after induction. Run the MH crisis: trigger off, oxygen, hyperventilation, dantrolene, cooling and the potassium.

objectives.text: Name malignant hyperthermia from the monitor: EtCO₂ above 45 mmHg at the same ventilation, tachycardia (instructor-assessed)
Call the MH crisis (stop sevoflurane, O₂ 100 % at 10 L/min, hyperventilate) within 120 s of the early signs (EtCO₂ above 45 mmHg at the same ventilation)
Give dantrolene 2.5 mg/kg within 300 s of calling the crisis

objectives: Repeat dantrolene 2.5 mg/kg within 600 s of the first dose while EtCO₂ is still above 45 mmHg

objectives.text: Treat the potassium (calcium chloride, insulin with dextrose) within 300 s of K⁺ rising above 5.5 mmol/L
Hyperventilation kept until EtCO₂ has stayed below 40 mmHg for 2 min, then ventilation normalised (back to 12 × 500)

takeHome: A rising EtCO₂ at the same ventilation with a rising heart rate: think of MH early.
Trigger off, 100 % oxygen at high flow, hyperventilation, and dantrolene 2.5 mg/kg.
Keep hyperventilating until the EtCO₂ has stayed down, and treat the potassium.
doc.notes: Showcase case (Stage 11; the induction sequence E119, 2026-10-24). MODELED: the physiology produces every change; the buttons only give what their label says. Oxygen is never implicit (E121): he breathes room air until Preoxygenate (face mask, 100 %), and the ventilator FiO₂ 0.5 comes with Intubate; induce without Preoxygenate and the apnoea before the tube desaturates. The MH condition starts at the succinylcholine (Induce); on this sequence the early signs come about 4.5 min after it (the premedication has left the CO₂ up). Measured course and bands: docs/plans/stage-11-scenarios.md; this sequence: the E119 rows of docs/showcase/SHOWCASE-2-RUN-SHEET.md.
